title: Xiaomi MiTV-MSSP0 / Xiaomi Mi TV 4A 32 (32-inch, codename amelie).
header:
Xiaomi MiTV-MSSP0 / Xiaomi Mi TV 4A 32 (32-inch, codename amelie).
Android TV 9 (SDK 28), firmware PI.5926 release-keys (incremental 5926), platform m5621.
Applied on 2026-10-19; these packages were still disabled on the same set on 2026-10-21.

Apply: TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/xiaomi-mitv-mssp0/debloat.txt
Undo:  TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/xiaomi-mitv-mssp0/debloat.txt
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Stock launcher: com.google.android.tvlauncher. It is deliberately NOT listed here;
launcher/build-and-install.sh handles its cutover after the replacement Home is installed.
Live TV: com.mediatek.wwtv.tvcenter, kept enabled along with the TV input services.
Gboard, Bluetooth, the phone remote service and firmware update settings were left alone.

Owner choices and checks:
- Assistant, Gallery and the Xiaomi media browser are disabled by owner choice.
Keep their packages enabled if you use those features.
- Before disabling Backdrop, install the launcher and select its Clock screensaver:
TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/tv.py 'settings put secure screensaver_components com.gathin.tvhome/.ClockDream'
- Home, clock and navigation were checked on the TV. The initial setup passed a reboot and
rollback/reapply check on 2026-10-19; Gallery and the media browser were disabled later that day.
- The input picker opened an HDMI session, but no connected source was available to test A/V.
- This is not the MiTV-MOOQ1 / tarzan or MiTV-MSSP3 / machuca firmware; do not merge their lists.
